method: Read final immutable artifacts against the original fixture and explicit later updates. Automated grades remain unchanged; semantic contradictions are recorded separately. This is an assistant audit, not a blinded independent human panel.

findings.traceSummary: The main model wrote the unsupported old-plan interpretation at input 7. At input 19 the original Playbooks rule was present in the selected context alongside derived notes, but the main model still wrote the cancellation as settled. The replica selected that new Journal note again at inputs 20 and 27. This does not establish that JEV caused the initial inference.

reviews.scope: Checked required fields, seven grounded boolean claims, three-library comparison, official citations, migration/rollback and unmeasured targets.

findings.observed: Final options replaced library comparison with architecture components and omitted Automerge.

Official URLs and executable concurrency/out-of-order tests are supplied in linked evidence/acceptance documents and JSON, rather than directly in the two files checked by the frozen grader. Do not describe these as wholly absent.

Model-selected policies are labeled 项目内定（人类未反对）; later migration plan calls scheduling risks 人类决定. Scripted user inputs contain no such approval. Routine proposed design choices are allowed, but their human-confirmed status is unsupported.

reviews.scope: Checked required fields, seven grounded boolean claims, linked evidence and acceptance plan, current constraints, migration/rollback and unmeasured targets.

findings.observed: toCSV includes full email. The distinct onsite export is private and its browser test passes.

Invalid registration returns unchanged core state with ok=false/errors instead of throwing. Repeated cancellation and backup preserve core data but alter metadata. Several frozen failures therefore concern error-return conventions/exact equality, not missing rejection or lost data. The brief did not explicitly require throwing on every invalid input.

findings.criterion: page renders after load and submit
findings.observed: App references roster-body, roster-count and roster-empty, which do not exist in final index.html. Browser throws TypeError on load and after submissions; records persist but the expected list does not render. Later smoke steps cannot complete.
toCSV includes full email, contrary to required private CSV contract.

register/cancel return a wrapper with state rather than the directly usable state specified by brief.md. This causes cascading failures in frozen API tests; it is not 23 independent algorithmic defects. Explicitly unwrapping results preserves core data and validation.

renderRoster uses publicRoster rows and passes person.id to handleCancel, but publicRoster strips id. Clicking the confirmed participant’s button displays 找不到这条报名 and leaves all five records unchanged.
richText is a descriptive string instead of the required boolean. The prose keeps rich-text collaboration in scope; do not label this as proof that the requirement was forgotten.

rainReviewBoundary: Operational additions are distinguished from revocation of an explicit rule. R1 lexical marks thresholds as inference and preserves the stated primary contingency; this limited audit does not endorse all discretionary additions.
scopeBoundary: Post-hoc assistant review covers material requirements and interface consistency, not an exhaustive proof of every technical assertion or application path. Acceptance means no material defect identified within the stated scope; it is not a new pre-registered aggregate score.
